mapper.select: SELECT group_user_id, group_id, user_id, group_user_status, approved_at, current_deposit_amount, streak_count, created_at, updated_at FROM group_users WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT gu.group_user_id, gu.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url FROM group_users gu JOIN users u ON gu.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.group_user_status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' ORDER BY gu.created_at ASC
SELECT group_user_id, group_id, user_id, group_user_status, approved_at, current_deposit_amount, streak_count, created_at, updated_at FROM group_users WHERE group_user_id = #{groupUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE group_users SET group_user_status = #{status}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACTIVE' THEN NOW() ELSE approved_at END WHERE group_user_id = #{groupUserId}
mapper.select: SELECT gu.group_user_id, gu.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, CASE WHEN g.user_id = gu.user_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS leader FROM group_users gu JOIN users u ON gu.user_id = u.user_id JOIN `groups` g ON gu.group_id = g.group_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.group_user_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY leader DESC, u.nickname
